department: Chandra Family Department of Electrical & Computer Engineering

deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026 (the page labels this the 2026-2027 cycle; it is the current deadline for the next fall intake).
deadline.quote: The deadline to complete and submit your application is December 1, 2026.

gre_general.quote: GRE scores are not considered in our application process.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

fee_waiver.value: ECE cannot waive the fee for international applicants; waivers are only for U.S. citizens/permanent residents with specific fellowships.
fee_waiver.quote: Texas ECE is unable to provide for an application fee waiver for our International applicants.

supervisor.value: The pages checked do not say whether you need a faculty advisor before admission; the admissions committee decides admission and funding together.

funding.value: Admitted PhD students get full financial support for the whole PhD (GRA, TA and/or fellowship), with no separate funding application.
funding.quote: Applicants admitted to our PhD program receive full financial support for the duration of your PhD study, which can include some combination of a graduate research assistantship (GRA), teaching assistantship (TA) and/or fellowship.

entry_route.value: A master's is not required; you choose MSE or PhD as your degree objective, and PhD students without a master's can earn the MSE along the way.
entry_route.quote: Is a Master’s required in order to apply to the PhD program? The Master’s degree (MSE) is not required in order to obtain the PhD.

notes: Applicants choose first and second academic tracks (8 tracks). Apply to either the MSE or the PhD, not both.
